text: Families ask for receipts for insurance, reimbursement and their own records. It takes one click.
Open the bill on Maria's ledger.
One button sends an invoice before payment, and a receipt after.
This bill is paid, so the button says Email receipt.
Check the address and the message.
On an unpaid bill, the same button says Email invoice.
For a statement of the whole household, use Email Ledger.

The most common mistakes are sending to an old email address, and sending an invoice when they wanted a receipt. Pay first, then send. Remember: the same button sends an invoice before payment and a receipt after.
